source_proposals.components_summary: proton transfer, unimolecular elimination by the conjugate base, assisted keto-enol tautomerisation, inferred reaction step
source_proposals.mechanism_text: Lys 331 acts as a general base to remove the 3-proton from 3-methyl aspartate to generate an enolic intermediate. An Mg(II) cation and His 194 provide positive charges to stabilise the accumulation of negative charge on the substrate carboxyl group during the formation of this intermediate. Collapse of the enolate leads to elimination of ammonia in an E1cB mechanism.

steps.summary: Lys331 abstracts the alpha proton from the substrate.
The negatively charged intermediate collapses, eliminating ammonia.
Inferred return step, using the product ammonia as the base.
